name: Wire Up Electric
old_description: At Wire Up Electric, we provide reliable, professional electrical services for homeowners and businesses throughout Wayne, NJ and North Jersey. From panel upgrades and EV charger installations to lighting, generators, and emergency repairs, we deliver safe, code-compliant work you can trust.
about:
Wire Up Electric is based in Wayne, New Jersey, and serves homeowners and businesses across North Jersey. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a range of electrical services including panel upgrades, EV charger installations, lighting, generator installations, and emergency repairs. Residential work covers home inspections, rewiring, troubleshooting, and LED lighting. Commercial services encompass LED lighting upgrades, maintenance contracts, office fit-outs, and data-cable installations. Generator offerings include standby generator installations, portable generator inlets, transfer switches, and interlock kits. Home automation and audio/video installations such as Nest thermostats, lighting controls, motorized blinds, Ethernet wiring, Wi-Fi access points, TV mounting, surround sound systems, and camera installations are also performed.

Customers include residential property owners and commercial clients in the North Jersey area. The company does not specify particular industry verticals beyond general residential and commercial sectors.

Wire Up Electric emphasizes punctuality, clear communication, and respect for clients' property, stating that quality workmanship and customer service are central to its approach.
